warp_render_module.detail: Warp v1.15.0 has no warp/_src/render.py and no offline CUDA renderer. warp/_src/render/ is render_opengl.py + render_usd.py + imgui_manager.py + utils.py; it requires a window/GL context and conflicts with AGENTS.md no-window boundary.

reference.why: MJWarp render/render_util/bvh are Python @wp.kernel code; Warp v1.15.0 provides no offline renderer. The only faithful reference is the frozen MJWarp Python stack, used only for authoring.
reference.product_boundary: No Python in product build/test; tests read frozen XML/MJB/NPZ/JSON only.
reference.fixture_policy: One XML; compile two MJBs (MuJoCo 3.12 for product, 3.15 for reference); prove render-relevant model arrays equal before comparing outputs.

delivery_tracking.policy: Rolling table only: slice -> task id -> owner -> status -> evidence path. Do not change slice scope, acceptance, or tolerances here.

slices.name: reference-fixture-parity
slices.scope: Commit one scene XML, compile MuJoCo 3.12 and 3.15 MJBs, dump render-relevant model arrays from both, and prove parity before any render comparison.
acceptance: both MJBs load with their matching MuJoCo version
all render-relevant arrays are element-wise equal: geom_*, cam_*, light_*, mat_*, tex_*, mesh_*, vis.headlight, vis.map.znear/zfar, stat.extent, name tables
any mismatch is written to parity.json with field/index/expected/actual and fails the slice
scripts are deterministic and their hashes are recorded

gpu.reason: CPU compile and array dump only

slices.name: reference-capture
slices.scope: Use the frozen MJWarp 3.15 stack to capture RGB/depth/seg images, fixed ray-hit traces, and context default receipts; run twice and record provenance.
acceptance: two consecutive captures produce identical sha256 for every output
ray set covers camera pixels, seeded random rays, grazing rays, and no-hit rays
context receipt contains resolved values for all 28 create_render_context parameters and output offsets
provenance is complete and the script does not read from the product tree
capture fails loudly if the reference environment differs

slices.name: render-model-input
slices.scope: Extend the native model ABI and Rust model with render-relevant camera, light, material, texture, mesh, vis, and name-table fields; host validation only.
acceptance: every render-relevant field read from the 3.12 MJB equals model-312.json element-wise
counts, lengths, strides, and products are checked for overflow/consistency
camera/light/material/texture/mesh name lookup matches mj_id2name semantics
invalid counts and negative sizes are rejected before allocation
no GPU is used

slices.name: scene-bvh
slices.scope: Build/refit/query a scene BVH for primitive geoms with per-world groups; expose semantic ray hits (geomid, distance, normal).
acceptance: for every fixed ray: geomid exact; distance <=4 ULP; normal <=1e-4 rad
AABBs are element-wise bit-equal to the reference before build
after moving a body and calling refit, the same ray set changes exactly as the reference
world groups do not cross-hit
empty scene and out-of-range group are rejected
no BVH node-layout assertions

slices.name: mesh-bvh
slices.scope: Build/refit a triangle BVH from mesh_vert/mesh_face and implement mesh ray hits with u/v/face/normal; support dynamic point updates.
acceptance: for every fixed mesh ray: triangle/face exact; u/v within 4 ULP; normal within 1e-4 rad
hit and miss agree with the reference, including backface cases
set_points + refit changes hits exactly as the reference
degenerate triangles are handled without panic
no node-layout assertions

slices.name: texture-upload
slices.scope: Convert MuJoCo uint8 texture data to float4, create/sample a CUDA texture object, keep a texture registry; skybox is interface-only.
acceptance: converted texels equal reference (u8/255) element-wise
dimensions and channel counts equal the reference
fixed uv-grid samples are <=1e-6 per channel versus reference
texture on/off render patch is within RGB tolerance
missing/zero-size textures are rejected

slices.name: camera-rays
slices.scope: Implement compute_ray, camera selection, ray buffers, znear/aspect/intrinsics, samples_per_pixel AA, and use_precomputed_rays=false.
acceptance: for each camera/projection: every pixel direction/offset matches reference (bits preferred, else <=1 ULP)
perspective and orthographic both covered
samples_per_pixel=1 and 2 produce reference-equal rays and AA image
empty camera list is valid
samples_per_pixel>1 without precomputed rays or without RGB is rejected
out_of_scope: dynamic per-world intrinsics beyond the reference fixture

slices.name: context-params
slices.scope: Implement RenderContext parameter parsing, None derivation, camera filtering, output offsets, znear/zfar, buffer sizes, and the rejection surface.
acceptance: default call resolves all 28 parameters exactly like context.json
bool/list/name/index/empty-list/heterogeneous-resolution call matrix resolves exactly
rgb/depth/seg offsets and buffer sizes match the reference
each invalid combination maps to the matching error category and field
no GPU render is required

gpu.reason: pure host resolution; GPU buffers are exercised in S6b

slices.name: context-lifecycle
slices.scope: Give RenderContext ownership of BVH, mesh, texture, and output resources; explicit create/destroy/refit; no implicit physics or BVH refresh.
acceptance: 100 create/destroy cycles keep GPU memory within a recorded threshold and show no use-after-free
moving geometry then render uses the old BVH; refit_bvh then render uses the new BVH (upstream semantics)
render never triggers physics or implicit refit
disabled outputs cannot be read
context drop releases all owned resources
out_of_scope: strict freshness facade (optional; not required by R01)

slices.name: render-launch-abi
slices.scope: Add a render launch ABI for scalars, vec3/vec4, u64, texture arrays/handles, and output buffers; keep NVRTC + W15 as the compile path.
acceptance: a test kernel round-trips every argument class with equal semantic values
wrong argument count/kind/alignment is rejected before launch
NVRTC compiles a compile-only kernel that includes builtin.h + bvh.h + texture.h from W15
texture handle lifetime survives the launch and is released on drop

slices.name: render-kernel
slices.scope: Hand-write a generic CUDA render kernel for primitive + mesh + texture scenes: ray cast, shading, RGB/depth/seg output, ambient/headlight/background, backface culling, vertex normals, specular/emission.
acceptance: fixture RGB every channel <=1 LSB, depth <=4 ULP, segmentation exact
two runs produce identical output hashes
texture on/off, vertex-normal on/off, specular/emission on/off, backface culling on/off match the reference
shadows, skybox, splats, flex, hfield are rejected or absent by design
per-pixel diff report lists the first mismatch and counts

slices.name: e2e-acceptance
slices.scope: Run the frozen fixture end to end: primitive + mesh + texture + two cameras, refit between frames, default context, RGB/depth/seg, lifecycle, and negative controls.
acceptance: all outputs pass the agreed tolerance
no Python is started by the test
repeat run hashes are identical
wrong camera, stale BVH, and disabled output are detected by the negative controls
receipt records versions, hashes, tolerances, and unverified items

risks.risk: Warp v1.15.0 has no offline renderer; the original render.py premise is wrong
risks.impact: cannot use Warp as the render reference
risks.mitigation: use frozen MJWarp Python reference; Warp provides low-level headers only; no OpenGL viewport

risks.risk: MuJoCo 3.12 product vs 3.15 reference model mismatch
risks.mitigation: S0a dual MJB + per-field parity gate; stop on mismatch

risks.risk: W15 has headers but not bvh.cpp/cu, mesh.cpp/cu, texture.cpp, cuBQL
risks.mitigation: S2/S3/S4 split; SAH/LBVH first; cuBQL only if needed

risks.risk: render kernel is large and Warp specializes it per model/context
risks.impact: 500-line slices and generic product kernel are hard
risks.mitigation: hand-written generic CUDA with runtime branches; generated Warp CUDA only as oracle; split S7b/S8

risks.risk: existing launch ABI accepts arrays only
risks.mitigation: S7a dedicated render launch ABI; follow existing per-kernel launcher pattern
freeze recipe; ULP budgets; record worst error

risks.risk: hardware texture filtering differs across GPUs
risks.mitigation: same-GPU reference; software sampling fallback with separate acceptance

risks.risk: license/provenance for cuBQL, CUDA, generated Warp code
risks.mitigation: Apache-2.0 notices; generated-source provenance; CUDA EULA needs decision
authoring scripts only; product tests read frozen files; CI check no Python
MVP scope; R05-R10 separate; explicit non-claims

decisions.recommendation: Keep product MuJoCo 3.12; reference uses 3.15; gate with dual MJB + per-field parity.
alternatives: Upgrade product native ABI to 3.15 (touches all existing native tests; not recommended in this item)

decisions.recommendation: Hand-write a generic CUDA kernel compiled through NVRTC + W15; use frozen Warp-generated CUDA only as an oracle.
alternatives: Freeze Warp-generated specialized CUDA for the fixture e2e (faster, but not general and not proof of product capability)

decisions.recommendation: Start with SAH/LBVH and semantic ray/image acceptance; add cuBQL only if tie/uv mismatches block acceptance.
alternatives: Port cuBQL up front (closer to upstream, more work and third-party surface)

decisions.recommendation: Accept the S0-S8 MVP scope and the proposed tolerance table.
